Here are the details of my reservation:

- Reservation Name: [Your Name]
- Reservation Number: [Your Reservation Number]
- Check-In Date: [Check-In Date]
- Check-Out Date: [Check-Out Date]
- Room Type: [Room Type]
- Number of Guests: [Number of Guests]

I am scheduled to arrive on [Check-In Date] and depart on [Check-Out Date]. I have planned my travel itinerary around this reservation and am looking forward to my stay at your hotel.

Could you please confirm the status of my reservation and provide me with an updated confirmation? If there are any additional steps I need to take to confirm my booking, kindly let me know at your earliest convenience.
